title: Ring Buffer Dump Lookup
brief: An embedded logger keeps unique, increasing sequence numbers in a ring buffer. When it crashes, the buffer is dumped from its first physical slot rather than from the write pointer, so the dump is in ascending order except that it starts partway through and wraps around.
Implement locateSequenceNumber(nums, target), where nums is the dumped buffer and target is a sequence number we are looking for, and return the zero-based position of target in nums.
